Container.Name: stream-scheduler
Container.Overview: Stream Scheduler schedules your weekly live streams on YouTube by itself, with the date of each stream already in the title, points your Wix or WordPress page at the coming stream, and tells you by email, Discord, Slack or Pushover when one needs you.[br][br]Open the WebUI to use the app. KEYRING_PASSWORD is required: it encrypts the sign-ins kept in appdata. Choose one and keep it.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: The app in a web browser.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Settings, schedules, history and the encrypted sign-ins.

Config.Name: Keyring password
Config.Description: Encrypts the sign-ins kept in appdata. Choose one now and keep it: with another password the saved sign-ins cannot be opened.

Config.Name: Web login
Config.Description: 1 to show a login page (user name and password, below) before the WebUI opens. Needs Secure connection set to 1.

Config.Name: Web login user name
Config.Description: User name for the login page, when Web login is 1.

Config.Name: Web login password
Config.Description: Password for the login page, when Web login is 1.

Config.Name: Secure connection
Config.Description: 1 to serve the WebUI over https (with a self-signed certificate, so the browser warns the first time). Needed for Web login.

Config.Name: VNC password
Config.Description: A simpler choice than Web login: one password (at most 8 characters) asked by the WebUI and port 5900, also over http.

Config.Name: Dark mode
Config.Description: 1 for a dark frame around the app in the WebUI (the app's own theme is in its Settings).

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: The user that owns the files in appdata (99 is nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: The group that owns the files in appdata (100 is users on Unraid).
